audit.corrected: Renamed Death Ray to Hextech Ray in flagged fields; cooldowns field now carries 140s/80s R and 6s Q numbers.

edits.before: - Malzahar Nether Grasp: matchup-defining — Point-and-click suppression — never step up solo while his passive shield is intact and R is up. It governs your forward steps. - W Gravity Field spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.

It governs your forward steps. - Call of the Void silences on a 6s cooldown — trade right after it whiffs. - Your W Gravity Field is 17s at rank 1: spent on poke, your anti-dive is gone.

edits.before: Malzahar wins by landing Nether Grasp, denying your pattern, and owning the spacing war until your tempo starves.
edits.after: Malzahar wins by farming safely under Void Shift, then suppressing you with Nether Grasp into his full Visions burst.

edits.before: Casting E at melee-adjacent range against a loaded engage — Viktor's cast times are an assassin's favorite metronome.

notes: Fixed fabricated 'Death Ray' -> real name Hextech Ray (Riot kit text) in the flagged field plus the other content fields using it. Content 'late'/'Gravity Field interrupts his channel': Viktor's R text explicitly interrupts channels, so I re-anchored the interrupt claim to Chaos Storm (W stun needs ~1.5s in-field, longer than his channel leaves reliable).
